ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT as of September t, 2020 ("Effective Date"), by NYCPI2 LLC, having an address at 51-17 92 Street, Elmhurst, NY 11373 (hereinafter referred to as "Owner"). WITNESSEH: WHEREAS, Owner is the owner in fee title of a certain parcel of land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, in Ridgewood, County of Queens and State of New York, known as Block 3435, Tax Lots 30 and more particularly described by metes and bound in Exhibit A-1 (hereinafter known as "Parcel A") and Block 3435, Tax Lot 29 and more particularly described by metes and bounds in Exhibit A-2 (hereinafter known as herein sometimes jointly referred to as the "Parcels" and each individually as a "Parcel") new building, with any further additions, alterations and replacements thereof, being herein called the "New Building"), Owner previously utilized the procedure available under the lot" for the purpose of ensuring that the New Building's floor area (herein referred to as "Floor Area"),as that term is defined in section 12 -10 of the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York effective December 15, 1961 (the "Zoning Resolution") complies with the "floor area ratio" limitation contained in the Zoning Resolution. WHEREAS, there exist unused "Available Floor Area Development Rights" (hereinafter defined) appurtenant to the Owner's Property comprising Parcel A and Parcel B which are in excess of the Floor Area Development Rights utilized on the Owner's Property as of the Effective Date. As used in this Agreement, the term "Floor Area Development Rights" shall mean the rights, as determined in accordance with the Zoning Resolution, which are appurtenant to a zoning lot, to develop such zoning lot by erecting thereon a structure or structures with a total floor area determined by (i) multiplying the area of such zoning lot by the basic maximum allowable floor area ratio for structures in the zoning district in which such zoning lot is located, and (ii) the inclusion of any available bonus floor area and any use, bulk, density and other development rights permitted under the ZoningResolution; WHEREAS, in order to construct the NewBuilding on Parcel B,Owner intends to both reserve and use on or pertinent to Parcel B, all Available Development Rights from the Owner's Property pursuant to the terms of this Agreement. As used in this Agreement, "Available Development Rights" shall mean all Floor Area Development Rights appurtenant to the Owner's Property minus the Floor Area now attributable to the building existing on Parcel A as of the Effective Date (hereinafter defined as

development rights resulting from any upward revision of the Floor Area Development Rights and any and all development rights and other benefits which may become available including additional Floor Development Rights resulting from a floor area bonus. Owner has reserved to itself, solely in its capacity as the owner of Parcel B and any successor in interest Rights, on the terms and conditions hereinafter set forth, it being understood and agreed, however, that Owner, solely in its capacity as the owner of Parcel A,is retaining for its own Section 2.1 and 2.2, any reference in the body of this Agreement to "Owner" shall hereinafter refer to Owner in its sole capacity as the owner of Parcel A. NOW THEREFORE, in consideration of Ten Dollars ($10.00) and other good and parties hereto agree as follows: ARTICLEI INTENTIONALLYOMITTED ARTICLEII DEVELOPMENTRIGHTS Section 2.1. Owner hereby reserves to the Parcel B Owners, all Available Development Rights from the Owner's Property and consents to Parcel B Owners' incorporation of the Available Development Rights into the NewBuilding on Parcel B and theParcel B Owners'utilization of the Available Development Rights to develop Parcel B or the Parcel B Owner's disposition of the Available Development Rights. Owner, solely in its capacity as the owner of Parcel A, shall retain all Retained Development Rights attributable to the building now existing on Parcel A as the same exists on the Effective Date, and the Parcel B Owners shall have no rights with respect to any of the Retained Development Rights. Section 2.2. Owner hereby reserves to the Parcel B Owners (i) a perpetual easement for light and air over the existing Parcel A such that the building now existing on Parcel A shall not exceed the building envelope existing as of the Effective Date and (i) a perpetual easement for the use of casement or similar windows so that they may open over the Parcel A. Section 2.3. Owner acknowledges that the Parcel B Owners may seek to either dispose of the Available Development Rights or acquire additional Floor Area Development Rights from any other source (hereinafter "Additional Floor Area Development Rights") so as to further increase the potential Floor Area of the New Building and consents to Parcel B Owner's disposition of the Available Development Rights or acquisition of suchAdditional Floor AreaDevelopment Rights and agrees that Parcel B Owners may incorporate into the New Building any Additional Floor Area Development Rights which Parcel B Owners may hereinafter acquire.
